sourceAnchors.name: validateTriggerInvocationExpressionAfterArgument
expressions: If a TriggerInvocationExpression has kind = after, then it must have an argument Expression with a result that conforms to the type Quantities::ScalarQuantityValue and a feature that directly or indirectly redefines Quantities::TensorQuantityValue::mRef and directly or indirectly specializes ISQBase::DurationUnit.

kind = TriggerKind::after implies     argument->notEmpty() and     argument->at(1).result.specializesFromLibrary('Quantities::ScalarQuantityValue') and     let mRef : Element =          resolveGlobal('Quantities::TensorQuantityValue::mRef').ownedMemberElement in     argument->at(1).result.feature->         select(ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature->            closure(ownedRedefinition.redefinedFeature)->            includes(mRef))->         exists(specializesFromLibrary('ISQBase::DurationUnit'))

sourceAnchors.name: validateTriggerInvocationExpressionAtArgument
expressions: If a TriggerInvocationExpression has kind = at, then it must have an argument Expression with a result that conforms to the type Time::TimeInstantValue.
kind = TriggerKind::at implies     argument->notEmpty() and     argument->at(1).result.specializesFromLibrary('Time::TimeInstantValue')

sourceAnchors.name: validateTriggerInvocationExpressionWhenArgument
expressions: If a TriggerInvocationExpression has kind = when, then it must have an argument that is a FeatureReferenceExpression whose referent is an Expression with a result that conforms to the type ScalarValues::Boolean.

kind = TriggerKind::when implies     argument->notEmpty() and     argument->at(1).oclIsKindOf(FeatureReferenceExpression) and     let referent : Feature =          argument->at(1).oclAsType(FeatureReferenceExpression).referent in     referent.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and     referent.oclAsType(Expression).result.specializesFromLibrary('ScalarValues::Boolean')

sourceAnchors.name: validateParameterMembershipOwningType
expressions: A ParameterMembership must be owned by a Behavior,Step, or the result parameter of a ConstructorExpression.

owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) or owningType.owningMembership.oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership) and     owningType.owningNamespace.oclIsKindOf(ConstructorExpression)

sourceAnchors.name: deriveInvocationExpressionArgument
expressions: The arguments of an InvocationExpression are the value Expressions of the FeatureValues of its ownedFeatures, in an order corresponding to the order of the input parameters of the instantiatedType that the ownedFeatures redefine.
instantiatedType.input->collect(inp |      ownedFeatures->select(redefines(inp)).valuation->     select(v | v <> null).value )

sourceAnchors.name: deriveFeatureReferenceExpressionReferent
expressions: The referent of a FeatureReferenceExpression is the memberElement of its first ownedMembership that is not a ParameterMembership.

referent =     let nonParameterMemberships : Sequence(Membership) = ownedMembership->         reject(oclIsKindOf(ParameterMembership)) in     if nonParameterMemberships->isEmpty() or        not nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclIsKindOf(Feature)     then null     else nonParameterMemberships->first().memberElement.oclAsType(Feature)     endif

sourceAnchors.name: validateReturnParameterMembershipOwningType
expressions: The owningType of a ReturnParameterMembership must be a Function or Expression.
owningType.oclIsKindOf(Function) or owningType.oclIsKindOf(Expression)

sourceAnchors.name: deriveExpressionResult
expressions: The result parameter of an Expression is its parameter owned (possibly in a supertype) via a ReturnParameterMembership (if any).

result =     let resultParams : Sequence(Feature) =         featureMemberships->             selectByKind(ReturnParameterMembership).             ownedMemberParameter in     if resultParams->notEmpty() then resultParams->first()     else null     endif

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureParameterRedefinition
expressions:
If a Feature is a parameter of an owningType that is a Behavior or Step, but not

  • A result parameter
  • A parameter of an InvocationExpression, with at least one non-implied ownedRedefinition

then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Behavior or Step, it must redefine the parameter at the same position, if any.

owningType <> null and not owningFeatureMembership.     oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership) and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Step) and     (owningType.oclIsKindOf(InvocationExpression) implies       not ownedRedefinition->exists(not isImplied))  implies     let i : Integer =         owningType.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->             reject(owningFeatureMembership.                 oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership))->             indexOf(self) in     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         forAll(supertype |             let ownedParameters : Sequence(Feature) =                 supertype.ownedFeature->select(direction <> null)->                      reject(owningFeatureMembership.                          oclIsKindOf(ReturnParameterMembership)) in             ownedParameters->size() >= i implies                 redefines(ownedParameters->at(i))

sourceAnchors.name: checkFeatureResultRedefinition
expressions: If a Feature is a result parameter of an owningType that is a Function or Expression, then, for each direct supertype of its owningType that is also a Function or Expression, it must redefine the result parameter.

owningType <> null and (owningType.oclIsKindOf(Function) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Function).result or  owningType.oclIsKindOf(Expression) and     self = owningType.oclAsType(Expression).result) implies     owningType.ownedSpecialization.general->         select(oclIsKindOf(Function) or oclIsKindOf(Expression))->         forAll(supertype |             redefines(                 if superType.oclIsKindOf(Function) then                     superType.oclAsType(Function).result                 else                     superType.oclAsType(Expression).result                 endif)

observations: The raw-model fixtures construct owned elements, reciprocal memberships, exact library input redefinitions and valuations before implied publication. No semantic cache is seeded and no generated row is forged. This exercises internal abstract-model construction, not a completed public CRUD or interchange API.

Each trigger kind proves an empty argument list both with no owned parameters and with an unvalued input. The active canonical conditional rule returns false without inventing a default. A malformed present FeatureValue remains incomplete rather than empty.

When-wrapper selection excludes both input and return ParameterMemberships. Empty wrappers and a first non-Feature member give a null referent; an ordinary Feature referent fails the Expression requirement. Boolean/integer Expression order controls the verdict; later valid members cannot replace an invalid first member.

A direct Boolean literal fails the required FeatureReferenceExpression wrapper test. A contradictory later member endpoint revokes the previously successful complete-membership proof rather than being ignored.

The new integer-expression case initially returned IncompleteProvider. The shared Feature requirements allowed authored Function/Predicate returns but omitted Expression returns, despite the normative ownership and result-redefinition rules.

The shared type-membership gate and Feature requirements now admit authored parameter roots of the already-supported Step families. Return membership additionally requires an Expression or Function owner. The complete owner-membership, positional-redefinition, direction, metadata, required-base and library proofs remain mandatory; no new inheritance algorithm or implicit edges are added.

Direct Step and Expression inputs/outputs/results typed by Integer now certify both the positive Integer specialization and the negative Boolean specialization. Inherited signatures and owned return selection are exercised. Exhausted query work fails and a fresh retry succeeds.

A further failing mutation exposed stale library-role name evidence: the loaded UUID table retained the original name after a raw declaration rename. The shared required-role reader now checks current declaredName as well as loaded identity, boundary and metaclass. A private test covers changed, null, numeric and empty names, held-proof invalidation and restoration. This leaf declaration check does not establish exhaustive global namespace/alias applicability.

Six mutations exercise checked authored Expression-return domains: changed return direction, missing ownership, mismatched narrowed membership endpoint, composite owner, incomplete metadata and missing required evaluations library identity. The direction constraint is independent: the selected Integer result still proves the Boolean trigger condition false. The other five mutations leave the trigger predicate incomplete.

corpus.method: Copy pinned sources and all 94 library files into the disposable test workspace before compiling and running the full model suite. No assertions are changed or skipped. Optional external Apollo corpus is absent.

initialFailure.finding: Integer-first, Boolean-second abstract when wrapper returned IncompleteProvider instead of false. Fixed the shared authored Expression-return domain rather than weakening the expected predicate or changing the fixture to a Function-owned return.

initialExpandedChecks.finding: Two overly broad test expectations were corrected: a malformed later member can exhaust the cumulative budget instead of reaching the local incomplete-provider error; changing return direction does not invalidate the independent false Boolean trigger predicate when the selected Integer result is unchanged. No production logic was weakened for either correction.

roleMutationFailure.finding: A renamed required evaluations declaration retained its loaded UUID and incorrectly continued to supply the old named role. The shared role lookup now requires the current declaration name. Native workspace, Clippy and the full model suite are rerun after this production fix.

review.method: Implementing-agent inspection of ten pinned XMI rules, shared-owner/positional dependency review, abstract-model tests, full vendor model suite and native workspace verification. No independent second review is claimed.
review.boundary: The expanded gates admit only existing supported Step membership families and still require a complete owning-signature certificate. General Invocation/Constructor domains and unaudited owner configurations remain incomplete.

remaining: The library-role name guard covers the requested leaf declaration. Full namespace/alias/shadowing and library-owner applicability still require broader dependency review.
Broader argument mappings, defaults, general invocation/operator/constructor result providers, authored reference-result contexts and legacy trigger bindings remain open.
The new abstract partitions are bounded evidence, not exhaustive validity of arbitrary graph shapes or a complete public abstract-model editing API.
AcceptActionUsage payload/receiver/isTriggerAction, inherited InvocationExpression obligations, transition/state defaults and library dependencies remain open.

Public conformance mappings, native/WASM parity, performance and desktop release gates remain pending for KERNEL-024; installed application remains KERNEL-023 and Windows/Linux evidence remains pending.
All fifteen completion packages remain open.
